newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Megaworld in new property jv.
newsitem.headline: Megaworld in new property jv.

text.p: Megaworld Property & Holdings Inc said on Tuesday it had signed a memorandum of agreement with Leonila Realty and Development Corp for the joint development of a prime urban property.
Leonila is an unlisted, domestic company.
The half-hectare property along Bohol avenue in suburban Quezon city is close to the country's premiere universities and schools, and near shopping centers, Megaworld said.

The land, which is owned by the family of the late President Carlos Garcia, will be developed into a residential community, with a retail and commercial area to provide shopping convenience to prospective residents, the statement added.
The company did not provide figures on the development cost of the project.
